name: SignalsDemo
summary: This EA is a GUI-based utility that demonstrates signal functionality through a dialog interface. It creates and manages a custom dialog window (CSignalsDemoDialog) on the chart for displaying or interacting with trading signals, but does not open positions itself.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于图形界面的工具，通过对话框展示信号功能。它在图表上创建并管理一个自定义对话框窗口（CSignalsDemoDialog），用于显示或交互交易信号，但本身不开仓交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个图形界面工具，而非策略交易程序。它通过继承CSignalsDemoDialog类创建了一个830x400像素的对话框窗口，用于展示信号相关信息。程序在OnInit中创建并运行对话框，在OnDeinit中销毁对话框以释放资源，并在OnChartEvent中将图表事件转发给对话框处理。由于没有包含任何交易逻辑、入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理代码，该EA不具备自主交易能力，仅作为信号展示和交互的界面工具存在。所有核心功能均封装在SignalsDemoDialog.mqh文件中，当前文件仅负责对话框的生命周期管理和事件路由。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is essentially a GUI utility rather than a strategy trading program. It creates an 830x400 pixel dialog window by inheriting from the CSignalsDemoDialog class, used for displaying signal-related information. The program creates and runs the dialog in OnInit, destroys it in OnDeinit to release resources, and forwards chart events to the dialog in OnChartEvent. Since there is no trading logic, entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management code included, this EA does not have autonomous trading capability and serves solely as an interface tool for signal display and interaction. All core functionality is encapsulated in the SignalsDemoDialog.mqh file, while the current file only handles dialog lifecycle management and event routing.
pros: 代码结构清晰，遵循MQL5标准EA框架模式
事件驱动架构设计合理，将图表事件正确转发至对话框处理
资源管理规范，在OnDeinit中正确销毁对话框防止内存泄漏
使用面向对象封装，将UI逻辑与主程序分离到独立的mqh文件中
pros_en: Clean code structure following standard MQL5 EA framework patterns
Well-designed event-driven architecture that correctly forwards chart events to the dialog
Proper resource management with dialog destruction in OnDeinit to prevent memory leaks
Object-oriented encapsulation separating UI logic into an independent mqh file
cons: 无任何交易逻辑或策略实现，功能极其有限
核心功能完全依赖外部文件SignalsDemoDialog.mqh，独立可分析性差
没有错误处理机制，对话框创建失败仅返回INIT_FAILED但无日志输出
缺少输入参数配置，对话框位置和尺寸均为硬编码值
cons_en: No trading logic or strategy implementation, extremely limited in functionality
Core functionality depends entirely on external SignalsDemoDialog.mqh file, poor standalone analyzability
No error handling mechanism — dialog creation failure only returns INIT_FAILED without any log output
Missing input parameters — dialog position and dimensions are all hard-coded values
improvements: 将硬编码的对话框位置和尺寸改为可配置的input参数，提升灵活性
添加Print日志输出以便调试对话框创建失败等异常情况
improvements_en: Convert hard-coded dialog position and dimensions to configurable input parameters for flexibility
Add Print log output for debugging exceptional cases such as dialog creation failure

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
对话框资源管理正确，无内存泄漏风险
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, no financial risk
Dialog resource management is correct, no memory leak risk
